yatra.title: London Europe Yatra
yatra.subtitle: with Hare Krishna Devotees — 8 countries
yatra.organiser: Bhakti Yatra by Hare Krishna Movement Indore · ISKCON Vijay Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh
yatra.price: ₹5,49,000 per person (including international flights) + 5% GST + 2% TCS (TCS refunded/credited through your income-tax return)

days.title: Fly to London Heathrow · Kamada Ekadasi
days.summary: International flight to London Heathrow (included), arriving in the afternoon or evening. Kamada Ekadasi: fruit meals on board. Welcome kirtan and dinner at an Indian restaurant in Wembley.

rows.detail: Report 3 hours before the flight. Group check-in; the tour manager hands over the kit (cap, bag, ID card, name badge). Today is Kamada Ekadasi: fruit meals are pre-ordered on the flight.
Economy group fare; flight details are shared at booking. Arrive at Heathrow in the afternoon or evening. Ekadasi: fruit meals on board; carry dry fruits and nuts.
UK Border (eVisa linked to the passport), baggage claim, meet the tour manager. Headcount.
Coach to the hotel. Welcome talk, group rules, WhatsApp group, SIM/eSIM help. Check-in and rest.
Hotel / Indian caterer – Ekadasi (grain-free) menu: fruit, potato, sabudana, paneer, nuts, milk.
Welcome kirtan and introduction to the tour programme. Tomorrow: break fast (Dvadasi parana) 05:59–10:40 at breakfast (08:00–09:00); coach 09:00. Jet lag: sleep by 23:00.

days.title: Madame Tussauds · ISKCON Soho · British Museum · Akshaya Patra · Bhaktivedanta Manor
days.summary: Morning at Madame Tussauds; darshan and prasadam lunch at ISKCON Soho, where Srila Prabhupada installed Radha-Londonishvara in 1969; the British Museum; a short stop at the Akshaya Patra kitchen in Watford; evening arati and dinner at Bhaktivedanta Manor.
days.short: Madame Tussauds · ISKCON Soho · British Museum · Bhaktivedanta Manor

rows.detail: Japa (16 rounds at own pace), short kirtan and Bhagavatam reading in the hotel hall or lobby (before breakfast; optional).
Hotel – complimentary buffet (08:00–09:00) – Dvadasi break fast between 05:59 and 10:40 (London). Break the Ekadasi fast with grains at breakfast.

rows.where: Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) → Madame Tussauds London
rows.detail: Coach via A40/Marylebone Road. Set-down at the attraction; the coach then parks in a booked bay. Order agreed with Vina World on 16 Nov: Tussauds first, then Soho and the British Museum, then Watford in the evening.
INSIDE VISIT – Madame Tussauds (about 3 h): Bollywood stars, the royal family, world leaders (Gandhi, Modi), sports and Marvel; 'Spirit of London' taxi ride. Timed group entry 10:00.
rows.note: Book the first group slot of the day (10:00).

rows.where: Madame Tussauds London → Coach set-down, Soho Square / Charing Cross Road
rows.detail: Coach to the Soho Square set-down (coaches cannot enter Soho's narrow streets).

rows.where: Coach set-down, Soho Square / Charing Cross Road → Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street)
rows.detail: Walk 200 m along Soho Street to the temple.

rows.where: Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street)
rows.detail: INSIDE VISIT – ISKCON Soho: darshan of Sri Sri Radha-Londonishvara, the first ISKCON deities in the UK, installed by Srila Prabhupada in 1969.

rows.where: Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street)
rows.detail: ISKCON Soho / Govinda's – prasadam lunch (group booking). Lunch at the temple, as agreed on 16 Nov.

rows.where: Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street) → British Museum
rows.detail: Walk 800 m up Charing Cross Road and Great Russell Street to the museum.
INSIDE VISIT – British Museum (about 2 h, free entry): Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies, the Parthenon sculptures, and the South Asia gallery with Amaravati stupa carvings and bronze Natarajas.
rows.note: New on 16 Nov. Group visits must be booked (free; groups of 10+ book a slot). Vina World to confirm the slot and whether it fits Day 2 within the 12-hour driver limit.

rows.where: British Museum → Coach pick-up, Russell Square
rows.detail: Walk to the coach pick-up on Russell Square.

rows.where: Coach pick-up, Russell Square → Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford
rows.detail: Coach north-west via A41 to Watford (Sunday traffic).

rows.where: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford
rows.detail: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford: short stop (about 20 min). Cooks up to 9,000 free school meals a day; founded by ISKCON Bangalore.
rows.note: Kept as a short stop 7 km from the Manor. The kitchen is usually not cooking on a Sunday: confirm with akshayapatra.org.uk/contact (tel. 020 800 48743) or drop it.

rows.where: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford → Bhaktivedanta Manor, ISKCON (Watford)
rows.detail: Short coach hop to Bhaktivedanta Manor (coach park on site).

INSIDE VISIT – Bhaktivedanta Manor: darshan of Sri Sri Radha-Gokulananda and Sita-Rama-Lakshmana-Hanuman, evening arati and kirtan, Srila Prabhupada's rooms, gardens and goshala. Story of George Harrison's gift of the Manor.
rows.note: The Manor's Sunday programme (kirtan and class) runs 11:30–13:00, so in the evening we get arati and kirtan, not the Sunday class. Tel. 01923 851000; tell them a 40-person group.

rows.detail: Indian restaurant, Watford (group booking, TBC) – or prasadam at the Manor (donation).

rows.where: Bhaktivedanta Manor, ISKCON (Watford) → Hotel, Wembley area (TBC)
rows.detail: Coach back to Wembley.
Tomorrow: coach 09:00 sharp. The Changing of the Guard is at 11:00. About 6 km of walking tomorrow: comfortable shoes, umbrella, water.

days.title: Royal London: Changing of the Guard · Tower of London (Koh-i-Noor) · Tower Bridge · Trafalgar Square · London Eye · Westminster
days.summary: Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace; the Tower of London with the Crown Jewels and the Koh-i-Noor; Tower Bridge; Trafalgar Square; the London Eye; Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament lit up at night.
days.short: Royal London: Guard · Tower & Koh-i-Noor · Trafalgar Square · London Eye

rows.detail: Japa (16 rounds at own pace), short kirtan and Bhagavatam reading in the hotel hall or lobby (before breakfast; optional).
Hotel – complimentary buffet (08:00–09:00).

rows.where: Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) → Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews)
rows.detail: Coach via A40/Park Lane to the set-down on Buckingham Palace Road (by the Royal Mews). Coaches may not wait on The Mall: the coach parks in a booked bay.
rows.note: Monday rush hour: leave on time. Coach must be ULEZ-compliant (Euro VI); the Congestion Charge applies 07:00–18:00.

rows.where: Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews) → Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard
rows.detail: Walk 500 m to the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace.

rows.where: Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard
rows.detail: PHOTO STOP – Buckingham Palace and the Changing of the Guard (King's Guard), 11:00–11:45: Foot Guards in red tunics and bearskins, the band, the handover of the keys. Best spots: Victoria Memorial steps or the palace railings.
rows.note: King's Guard changes Mon/Wed/Fri at 11:00. Free. Cancelled in very wet weather: check householddivision.org.uk the evening before. The King's Gallery was dropped on 16 Nov.

rows.where: Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard → Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews)
rows.detail: Walk back to the coach on Buckingham Palace Road.

rows.where: Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews) → Tower Hill coach park (Lower Thames Street)
rows.detail: Coach along the Embankment past Westminster and St Paul's to Tower Hill coach park.

rows.where: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (TBC)
rows.detail: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (to be booked). Backup: packed Satvik lunch.

rows.where: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (TBC) → Tower of London – Crown Jewels (Kohinoor)
rows.detail: Walk 300 m to the Tower's group entrance.

INSIDE VISIT – Tower of London: first the Jewel House for the Crown Jewels, including the Koh-i-Noor in the Queen Mother's crown (its journey from Golconda/Kollur near Hyderabad to London); then a Yeoman Warder tour, the White Tower, the ravens and the walls.
rows.note: Book a timed group entry (13:30) with the Historic Royal Palaces groups desk (15+ rate).

rows.where: Tower of London – Crown Jewels (Kohinoor) → Tower Bridge
rows.detail: PHOTO STOP – walk onto Tower Bridge and back: photos, HMS Belfast, the Shard. The Thames cruise was dropped on 16 Nov to save time.

rows.where: Tower Bridge → Tower Hill coach park (Lower Thames Street)
rows.detail: Walk back to the Tower Hill coach park.

rows.where: Tower Hill coach park (Lower Thames Street) → Trafalgar Square
rows.detail: Coach along the Embankment to the Trafalgar Square set-down (Northumberland Avenue).
PHOTO STOP – Trafalgar Square (new on 16 Nov): Nelson's Column, the lions, the National Gallery front and the fountains.
Walk over the Golden Jubilee footbridge to the South Bank.
INSIDE VISIT – London Eye: 30-minute rotation in evening light (timed group slot 18:00): Parliament, Buckingham Palace, St Paul's, the Shard. Step-free.
rows.note: Timed-slot tickets agreed with Vina World. Group rate 10+.

rows.where: London Eye → Indian restaurant near Westminster / Waterloo (TBC)
rows.detail: Walk to the restaurant near Westminster Bridge Road.
Indian restaurant near Westminster / Waterloo (group booking, TBC).

rows.where: Westminster – Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
rows.detail: PHOTO STOP – Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower), the Houses of Parliament and Westminster Bridge lit up after sunset (~20:07). Parliament Square statues including Mahatma Gandhi.
rows.note: Outside only: nobody goes inside Parliament on a sitting Monday.

rows.where: Westminster – Big Ben & Houses of Parliament → Coach pick-up, Victoria Embankment (Westminster Pier)
rows.detail: Walk to the coach pick-up on Victoria Embankment by Westminster Pier.

rows.where: Coach pick-up, Victoria Embankment (Westminster Pier) → Hotel, Wembley area (TBC)
rows.detail: Coach back to Wembley.
Pack tonight: luggage in the lobby at 05:00. Tomorrow is a 05:30 start for the 08:00 Eurostar. Passports in hand luggage: UK exit and French entry happen at St Pancras.

days.title: Eurostar to Paris · Paris orientation · Notre-Dame · Seine cruise · ISKCON Paris · Balarama Rasayatra
days.summary: The 08:00 Eurostar under the English Channel to Paris (packed breakfast). Paris orientation: the Arc de Triomphe, the Champs-Élysées, Notre-Dame and the Île de la Cité; a Seine cruise; evening arati and dinner at ISKCON Paris. Balarama Rasayatra.
days.short: Eurostar → Paris · Notre-Dame · Seine · ISKCON Paris

rows.detail: Packed breakfast from the hotel: one fruit, one juice and a bread roll or sandwich (thepla to be added if possible). EXCEPTION to the 08:00–09:00 breakfast: the 08:00 Eurostar needs a 05:30 departure.
Check-out, luggage loaded, headcount. One 4-wheel check-in bag, one wheeled cabin bag and one backpack per yatri.

rows.where: Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) → London St Pancras International (Eurostar)
rows.detail: Coach to St Pancras International (the UK coach's last run). Today is Balarama Rasayatra: kirtan on the train.
St Pancras: group check-in, security, UK exit and French entry. First entry into Schengen: the EU Entry/Exit System (EES) takes fingerprints and a face photo. Station trolleys £1 a bag.
rows.note: Eurostar asks groups to arrive 90 minutes before departure. Keep passports and visa copies in hand.

rows.where: London St Pancras International (Eurostar) → Paris Gare du Nord (Eurostar)
rows.detail: Eurostar London St Pancras → Paris Gare du Nord (2 h 16 m; clocks go forward 1 h). 50 km under the English Channel through the Channel Tunnel. Replaces the Dover ferry (agreed 16 Nov).
rows.note: Group booking for the 08:01 departure (the '08:00 train'); about £1 a bag for trolleys in London, €1 in Paris.

inclusions: All sightseeing as in the itinerary
visa: UK visa: apply from about 17 Jan 2027 (max 3 months before); decision usually 3 weeks after biometrics. Schengen: apply to Italy (longest stay) between Jan and early Mar 2027 (max 6 months, min 15 days before); normally 15 days, up to 45. Do UK first, then Schengen.
Current passport + previous passports if any. Print the first and last pages, plus pages with travel history (black & white is fine). Valid 3+ months beyond 3 May 2027 and 2 blank pages.
Schengen visa photos, 35 mm × 45 mm, white background, matte or glossy, no spectacles, 2 copies. Do not bring ordinary passport-size photos.
Personal or company ITR-V acknowledgement for the last 3 financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Balance sheet not needed.
Personal or company account, last 3 months, sealed and signed by the bank. Minimum balance about ₹3 lakh per person.
On company letterhead, or plain paper if there is none, signed by the sponsor (self, spouse or company). Add an explanation letter with proof for any sudden large deposit.
If travelling on company funds or showing company ITR-V and bank statements: company registration or GST registration certificate.
Provided by organisers at the biometric office

Covering letter from Goldenavatar Ventures Pvt Ltd for the group, its ITR-V (3 years), 3-month sealed bank statement and incorporation letter, travel insurance (must cover the UK too), hotel confirmations, flight tickets, the filled visa application form.
£135 Standard Visitor visa, issued as an eVisa linked to the passport (each yatri creates a UKVI account). No UK ETA needed with a visa. Keep a scan of every Schengen document; most are reused.
dos: Carry your passport, visa and insurance card on travel days; keep a photocopy separately.
Be at the coach 5 minutes before the departure time announced.
Wear comfortable walking shoes already broken in; 10,000–15,000 steps on city days.
Dress modestly for churches and the Vatican: shoulders and knees covered, no caps inside.
Keep a small day-bag: water, cap, sunscreen, umbrella, light jacket, medicines, chargers.
Pre-inform the tour manager of medical conditions and dietary needs.
Use the buddy system; keep your phone on and charged (power bank).
Respect temple etiquette abroad: shoes off, no photos of deities where asked, offer a donation if you wish.
Keep coins of EUR and CHF for toilets (often €0.50–€1).
Ask for VAT refund forms on purchases over the minimum (varies by country).
Drink plenty of water, especially in Italy.
Keep the coach clean; take your waste with you.
donts: Don't carry valuables or large amounts of cash in back pockets or open bags.
Don't sign petitions or accept 'free' bracelets or roses from strangers (common scams).
Don't wander off alone; never leave the group without telling the tour manager.
Don't bring banned food items from India (meat, dairy, fresh fruit and vegetables into the UK/EU). Packaged food is mostly fine; declare it if in doubt.
Don't climb the Leaning Tower or do the Titlis Cliff Walk if you have heart, BP or knee problems.
Don't take photos in the Sistine Chapel or where signs prohibit it.
Don't eat in the coach unless permitted by the driver; no hot food.
Don't block the bus aisle or leave bags in the stairwell.
Don't buy from street sellers near monuments (counterfeit goods; fines in Italy and France for buyers).
Don't overstay your visa or lose your stamps; keep boarding passes until home.
practical: Weather in late April
15–21 °C by day, 6–11 °C at night, rain on 3–5 days in 11. Titisee mornings near freezing. Titlis summit −2 to −7 °C with snow. Sunset 20:00–21:00.
Currency
UK: GBP (£). France, Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, Vatican: EUR (€). Switzerland: CHF (EUR widely accepted at a poor rate). A multi-currency forex card plus a little cash in each.
Power plugs
UK: Type G (3-pin). Europe: Type C/F (2 round pins). Switzerland: Type J (Type C fits). Carry a universal adapter and a power bank.
Mobile & data
An international roaming pack or a Europe + UK eSIM. Switzerland is often excluded from EU packs, so check. Make WhatsApp the group channel.
Time zones
UK = IST − 4 h 30 m (BST). France to Italy = IST − 3 h 30 m (CEST).
Emergency numbers

UK 999 / 112; EU and Switzerland 112. Indian High Commission London +44 20 7836 8484 (verify); Indian embassies in Paris, Brussels, The Hague, Berlin, Bern and Rome (save their numbers before departure).
Senior-citizen care
Seats near the front, wheelchair booking at the Louvre, Vatican and airports, extra rest stops, a medicine pouch with prescriptions, an attendant ratio of 1:10, lifts used wherever available.
Packing

Warm jacket + fleece + thermal layer, gloves, woollen cap (Titlis), Ekadasi snacks for 17 Apr and 2 May, 4–5 sets of clothes + 1 dhoti/saree set for temples, raincoat or umbrella, cap, sunglasses, walking shoes + slippers, tulasi beads, japa bag, small Gita, medicines for 20 days, ORS, sunscreen, an empty bottle, a small towel, a lock for suitcases, a laundry bag.
Water & toilets
Tap water is drinkable in the UK, France, Switzerland and most of Italy. Public toilets often charge €0.50–€1; use temple, restaurant and museum toilets.
Shopping & VAT refund

Paris: perfumes and fashion; Switzerland: chocolates, watches, cuckoo clocks (Titisee); Italy: leather goods, Murano glass (Venice). Ask for a tax-free form and get it stamped at Malpensa customs before check-in.
challenges: Vatican day has no backup
Vatican Museums are closed on 1 May and on Sundays, so Fri 30 April is the only day. It depends on the early Frecciarossa from Venice-Mestre.
Book the group slot early. Watch the Italian strike register from mid-April (strikes are announced 10–12 days ahead). Backup: our coach Mestre → Rome (about 5 h).
First EU biometric check (EES) at St Pancras
Every yatri gives fingerprints and a photo at first Schengen entry (live since 10 Apr 2026), done at St Pancras before the Eurostar.
Be at St Pancras 90 minutes before the 08:01 train; passports and visa copies in hand.
Two Ekadasis on travel days
Kamada Ekadasi on 17 Apr (outbound flights) and Varuthini Ekadasi on 2 May (flights home).
Pre-order fruit meals (FPML); carry Ekadasi snacks; grain-free hotel dinner on 17 Apr; break fast in London 05:59–10:40 on 18 Apr and in India before ~10:00 on 3 May.
Cold and wet spring weather
London 7–15 °C with showers; Black Forest near 0 °C at night; Titlis summit about −5 °C in snow; Italy 10–21 °C.
Warm jacket, thermal layer, gloves and cap for Titlis; umbrellas; non-slip shoes.
Holidays and events
1 May Labour Day in Italy (Rome/Pisa crowds; Colosseum closed); French presidential election 18 Apr and 2 May; Keukenhof and Zaanse Schans busy on Saturday.
Pre-book all timed entries; go early; avoid political rallies in Paris.
Central London coach rules
Coaches cannot enter Soho or Covent Garden, cannot wait at Buckingham Gate, The Mall or outside attractions; ULEZ (Euro VI coach) and the Congestion Charge apply.
Coach operator to pre-book coach bays (TfL coach parking map), use set-down/pick-up points in the timetable, and keep the group to time at every pick-up (the coach cannot wait).
Pickpockets
London (Changing of the Guard crowd, Trafalgar Square), Paris (Eiffel, Louvre, Métro), Rome (Trevi, Colosseum, Termini station), Venice crowds.
Neck pouches, zipped bags worn in front, passports in the hotel safe except on ticket days, buddy system.
Satvik food availability
Most restaurants use onion and garlic; few Indian restaurants in small towns.
Written no-onion/no-garlic menus; temple prasadam on 5 meals; packed lunches on 2 days; carry ready meals and dry snacks.
Senior citizens' stamina
Long walks (Louvre, British Museum, Vatican, Venice), steps (Pisa, Venice bridges), altitude (Titlis), 05:00 starts on Days 4 and 14 and 04:30 on Day 16.
Wheelchairs at museums, rest after the Vatican on Day 14, slow group with an assistant, pre-departure medical check.
Visas and biometrics
UK visa can be applied for only 3 months before travel; Schengen up to 6 months before. Passports are held during processing.
UK first (mid-to-late Jan 2027), then Schengen via Italy (by late Feb / early Mar 2027).
Lost passport or luggage
12 hotels in 15 nights; luggage travels separately on Days 11 and 14.
Group luggage tags, a daily luggage count, scans of passports and visas, Indian embassy contacts.
